      <div class="proj-title">VC Deal Sourcing</div>
      <div class="proj-sub">A free-data pipeline that finds and ranks startups against an investment thesis.</div>
      <div class="proj-block">
        <div class="proj-block-label">Context</div>
        <div class="proj-block-text">First-pass deal screens usually depend on paid databases. I wanted to know whether public filings and a free accelerator directory could produce a usable ranked list.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="proj-block">
        <div class="proj-block-label">Approach</div>
        <div class="proj-block-text">Pulled companies from SEC Form D and the Y Combinator directory, cleaned and de-duplicated them, enriched a subset with GitHub and Hacker News signals, and scored each name 0–100 against a thesis with an explainable weighted breakdown.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="proj-block">
        <div class="proj-block-label">Outcome</div>
        <div class="proj-block-text">438 companies scored end-to-end. Changing the thesis from AI infrastructure to healthcare moved healthcare from 0% to 43% of the top 30. The two sources never overlapped.</div>
      </div>
      <a href="Insights/two-sources-zero-overlap.html" class="arrow-link">Read the write-up →</a>
      <a href="https://github.com/eeshajagdhane/vc-deal-sourcing" class="arrow-link" target="_blank" rel="noopener">View on GitHub →</a>
    </div>

      <div class="proj-block">
        <div class="proj-block-label">Context</div>
        <div class="proj-block-text">Dashboards inherit silent data problems — missing dates, duplicated keys, out-of-range values — unless something refuses to load them.</div>

        <div class="proj-block-label">Approach</div>
        <div class="proj-block-text">Pulled unemployment, GDP, and 10-year Treasury yields from FRED, transformed them into a tidy table, and ran five quality checks. Only series that passed every check were upserted into DuckDB.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="proj-block">
        <div class="proj-block-label">Outcome</div>
        <div class="proj-block-text">Failed series write a timestamped QA report and never enter the analytics table. Value nulls from FRED's missing marker are reported, not rejected.</div>
